_documentation.UrlsBinding: By default, Hypera.Server binds to http://0.0.0.0:5080 when neither ASPNETCORE_URLS, --urls/urls, nor Kestrel:Endpoints is configured.
_documentation.KestrelOverrideExample: To customize bindings or TLS, add a Kestrel:Endpoints section or set ASPNETCORE_URLS.
_documentation.DataRoot: Relative paths are resolved against ContentRootPath; stores hypera.db, packages/, sources/, saves/, and locales/*.json.
